user.title: KEBA Wallbox Modbus
user.description: Configure the wallbox Modbus TCP connection and polling intervals.

data_description.host: IP address or DNS name used for Modbus TCP.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID used when reading and writing KEBA registers. Direct wallbox access usually uses 255.
data_description.port: TCP port for Modbus TCP. KEBA wallboxes usually use 502.
data_description.timeout: How long Home Assistant waits for each Modbus response.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the wallbox.
data_description.slow_runtime_poll_interval: How often slower runtime and configuration values such as total energy, phase switch source and failsafe settings are polled.
data_description.model: Automatic detects the model from the wallbox. Select P30 or P40 if the model is not detected correctly.

p30_udp.name: P30: UDP display
p30_udp.description: Optional settings for P30 wallboxes with a display.

data_description.udp_host: Optional separate IP address or DNS name used for UDP display commands. Leave empty to use the Modbus host.
data_description.display_min_time: Default minimum duration for display messages sent without a custom value.
data_description.display_max_time: Default maximum duration for display messages sent without a custom value.
